sloka: ब्रह्मणा नरशार्दूल तेन इदम् मानसम् सरः ।तस्मात् सुस्राव सरसः सा अयोध्याम् उपगूहते ॥१-२४-९॥
transliteration: brahmaṇā naraśārdūla tena idam mānasam saraḥ ।tasmāt susrāva sarasaḥ sā ayodhyām upagūhate ॥1-24-9॥

translations.english: This river which flows from Manasa Sarovara is, therefore, known as 'Sarayu'. It surrounds Ayodhya. This sacred river flows from that lake of Brahma.
